reports.title: TransMedics Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

guidance.heading: 2026 Financial Outlook
section: TransMedics raises its full-year 2026 revenue guidance. The table below summarizes the updates:

Prior Guidance | Updated Guidance | Implied Annual Growth(compared to FY 2025 revenue)
FY 2026 Revenue(excluding PAD Aviation) | $737-$757 million | $750-$760 million | 24% to 26%
FY 2026 Revenue(including PAD Aviation) | --- | $764-$774 million | 26% to 28%
